justification: Standard: adds a second outbound email on a customer-facing route. Not Critical: no regulatory data, no schema change.

pre_impl.existing_data: canibuildit_leads: 6 real rows after deleting 3 owner test rows (backup data/db_rollback_backups/canibuildit_leads_owner_tests_pre_2026-10-28T110543.json).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Sending the alert to info@plotdetect.com.au would be quarantined by Google Workspace as self-domain mail; app/api/feedback/route.ts already routes to NOTIFY_EMAIL for this reason.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the NOTIFY_EMAIL pattern from the feedback route; no new surface or env var.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Resend {error} or throw is logged and the request still returns ok, since the lead is stored.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the alert fails, the person sees no difference; the failure is in server logs and the lead is in the table.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Run with the operator alert call removed from route.ts
falsifiable_check.observed_red: lead-abuse happy-path tests expect 2 sends with the second subject starting 'Lead: '; with no alert they receive 1 and fail.

functions.name: buildLeadAlert
functions.input: lead fields after validation and storage
functions.output: a plain-text subject and body for the operator
functions.if_none: optional fields omitted; missing consent says so

functions.name: notifyOperatorOfLead
functions.input: the same lead fields for one stored lead
functions.output: true when Resend accepted the send
functions.if_none: no API key returns false without throwing

break_it.scenario: An attacker puts HTML or a script in the address field
break_it.what_happens: It could render in the operator's inbox
break_it.how: The alert is plain text only, with no html part

break_it.scenario: Resend is down when a lead arrives
break_it.what_happens: The operator gets no alert for that lead
break_it.how: The lead is still stored and logged; the request still returns ok

break_it.scenario: A duplicate submission of the same email and address within 24 hours
break_it.what_happens: The operator could get repeated alerts for one person
break_it.how: The duplicate check returns before the insert, the email and the alert

post_merge.secrets: No - uses the existing RESEND_API_KEY and optional NOTIFY_EMAIL
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - submit one lead after deploy and confirm the alert reaches NOTIFY_EMAIL
